description: This CSS file defines style variables for both light and dark themes, as well as styles for various components of a React application including the main app container, logo, header, and theme toggle button.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application layout with text alignment and background color transitions based on selected theme.

classes.name: App-logo
classes.description: Styles for the logo of the application, including size and animation effects.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Styles for the application header, including background color, layout properties, and font settings.

classes.name: App-link
classes.description: Styles for application links, incorporating color transitions.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Styles for the theme toggle button, including position, color, padding, and hover effects.

methods.name: App-logo-spin
methods.description: Keyframe animation for spinning the application logo continuously.
